title: Freeze Bug
can_do: 把一个自创游戏的规则一步步讲给别人听，并确认对方听懂。

conversation_move.label: explain the rules of a made-up game

trigger: Child invents a game and teaches it to Max, step by step.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Max, I made up a new game! It's called Freeze Bug.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Freeze Bug? How do you play it?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: We run like bugs until someone says freeze.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Then what happens when we freeze?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: You stop like a statue, and count to five slowly.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: What if I move while counting?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then you're the next bug caller. That's the rule!

replay_cards.title: Teaching Grandma the game
replay_cards.change: She has never played Freeze Bug.
replay_cards.challenge: Child explains the rules step by step, checks that she understands, and they play one slow round in the living room.

replay_cards.title: The obstacle course
replay_cards.setting: A rainy afternoon with pillows and a mat.
replay_cards.challenge: Child explains the route to Dad, answers his questions, and watches him try it.

parent_support: 让孩子把自创游戏的规则教给大人，大人认真当学生。
听不懂的地方真实地追问，给孩子“再讲一遍”的机会。
规则讲完真的照玩一轮，让教学有结果。
